weather.fog.label: Fog
weather.fog.help: Coastal fog over cold upwelling water: cool, dry coasts that live on the fog.
weather.foehn.label: Föhn
weather.foehn.help: Warm, dry wind down the lee of a range.
weather.rainVariability.label: Rain variability
weather.rainVariability.help: How far one year's rain strays from the mean: dry lands and monsoon margins vary most.
weather.enso.label: ENSO see-saw
weather.enso.help: In the warm phase an equatorial ocean's warm water sloshes east: its eastern shores get rain, its western shores drought.
